M_report_snapshot.token_scope: Final m_answer input only; all directory, retrieval, extraction and planning calls listed separately.
M_report_snapshot.timing_policy: Shared GPU observations; not a controlled speed comparison.
M_report_snapshot.comparison_policy: M changes source retrieval; historical L scores are not a same-runtime control.

semantic_diagnostics.limitation: Autonomous early stopping can mistake a partial option match for full discrimination.

M_report_snapshot.functional_gate_scope: Technical planning, source, gap execution and complete-pipeline contracts; autonomous semantic sufficiency is a separately reported diagnostic.

matching: Identical first N question IDs, question/options and gold labels verified; only completed M results included.
limitations: Not a same-runtime or same-source ablation; M changes retrieval and evidence acquisition.
L reuses historical H/I construction; L planning-plus-answer time excludes upstream acquisition and extraction.
M empty candidates skip extraction and evidence planning; zero planner time is included in its per-question stage mean.
Shared GPU timings are observations, not a controlled speed comparison. Setup, historical failed attempts and unfinished query costs excluded from matched-row means.
